why: 2. cümledeki 'woke up' (uyandıklarında), 'the chimpanzees' ve 'the mark' (işaret) ifadeleri; uyuşturmanın, şempanzelerin ve işaretin önceden anlatılmasını gerektirir. Üçü de yalnızca eksik cümlede geçer.
tr: Uyuşturulmuş şempanzelerin alnına kokusuz kırmızı bir işaret koydu ve ardından onlara bir ayna verdi.

sentences: In 1569, the Flemish mapmaker Gerardus Mercator published a world map designed for sailors.
Its great advantage was that a line of constant compass direction appeared as a straight line.
As a result, Greenland appears about as large as Africa, although Africa is actually fourteen times bigger.
Despite this distortion, the projection is still used today by most online mapping services.
missing: To achieve this, however, Mercator had to stretch the regions near the poles enormously.
why: 3. cümledeki 'As a result' (sonuç olarak) Grönland'ın büyük görünmesinin bir sebebini gerektirir. Sebep eksik cümlededir: kutuplara yakın bölgelerin gerilmesi. 'To achieve this' de 2. cümledeki avantaja atıf yapar.
tr: Ancak Mercator bunu başarmak için kutuplara yakın bölgeleri muazzam ölçüde germek zorunda kaldı.

sentences: In 1928, the Scottish bacteriologist Alexander Fleming returned from a holiday to find mold growing on one of his bacterial cultures.
Around the mold, the bacteria had been destroyed, leaving a clear ring.
Fleming named the substance responsible penicillin, but he found it difficult to produce in useful quantities.
Only in the early 1940s did Howard Florey and Ernst Chain develop methods to purify it, just in time to save countless soldiers in the Second World War.
missing: For more than a decade, his discovery therefore attracted little attention.
why: 'therefore' (bu yüzden), 3. cümledeki 'yeterli miktarda üretmek zordu' bilgisinin sonucudur. 4. cümledeki 'Only in the early 1940s' (ancak 1940'ların başında) ifadesi de eksik cümledeki 'on yılı aşkın ilgisizlik'le zıtlık kurar.
tr: Bu yüzden keşfi on yılı aşkın bir süre pek ilgi görmedi.

sentences: In 1961, a small team of American advisers approved a plan to invade Cuba at the Bay of Pigs.
The plan was deeply flawed, and the invasion failed within three days.
The psychologist Irving Janis later studied how such intelligent people could have made such a poor decision.
He concluded that the group's desire for harmony had discouraged members from voicing their doubts.
missing: Janis called this pattern groupthink, a term now widely used to describe faulty decision-making in close-knit teams.
why: 'this pattern' (bu örüntü) ifadesi 4. cümledeki 'uyum isteğinin şüpheleri susturması' sonucuna işaret eder. Eksik cümle bu bulguyu adlandırarak paragrafı kapatır.
tr: Janis bu örüntüye 'grup düşüncesi' adını verdi; bu terim bugün sıkı bağlı ekiplerdeki hatalı karar verme sürecini anlatmak için yaygın olarak kullanılıyor.

sentences: Pacific salmon hatch in freshwater streams but spend most of their adult lives far out in the ocean.
To find their way across open water, they appear to rely partly on the Earth's magnetic field.
Once they reach the coast, however, smell takes over as their main guide.
Experiments show that each stream has a unique chemical signature, which young salmon memorize before leaving for the sea.
missing: After several years at sea, they return to spawn in the very stream where they were born.
why: 2. cümledeki 'To find their way' (yollarını bulmak için) ifadesi bir varış noktasını gerektirir. Bu nokta eksik cümledeki 'doğdukları dere'dir; geri dönüş yolculuğu yalnızca eksik cümlede anlatılır.
tr: Denizde birkaç yıl geçirdikten sonra yumurtlamak için tam da doğdukları dereye geri dönerler.

sentences: In 1920, the United States banned the production and sale of alcoholic drinks nationwide.
Supporters hoped that the ban would reduce crime, improve public health, and strengthen families.
Criminals such as Al Capone grew enormously rich by smuggling and selling liquor.
Facing widespread violence and lost tax revenue, the government repealed the ban in 1933.
missing: Instead, it created a vast illegal market for alcohol that was quickly taken over by organized gangs.
why: 'Instead' (bunun yerine) 2. cümledeki umutların tersine dönen sonucu verir. 3. cümledeki Al Capone gibi suçlular da eksik cümledeki 'organize çeteler'in örneğidir.
tr: Bunun yerine yasak, kısa sürede organize çetelerin eline geçen devasa bir yasa dışı alkol piyasası yarattı.

sentences: In 1993, the psychologist Anders Ericsson studied violin students at a music academy in Berlin.
He found that the best performers had accumulated about ten thousand hours of practice by the age of twenty.
The writer Malcolm Gladwell later popularized this figure as the '10,000-hour rule' for achieving mastery in any field.
What mattered most, he stressed, was not the quantity of practice but its quality, especially focused work on specific weaknesses.
missing: Ericsson himself, however, objected that the number was only an average and not a magic threshold.
why: 4. cümledeki 'he stressed' (diye vurguladı) Ericsson'a aittir. Eksik cümle olmadan bu zamir 3. cümledeki Gladwell'e gider ve anlam bozulur. 'however' (ancak) da Gladwell'in kuralına Ericsson'un itirazını gösterir.
tr: Ancak Ericsson'un kendisi bu sayının yalnızca bir ortalama olduğunu, sihirli bir eşik olmadığını söyleyerek itiraz etti.

sentences: Each year, a tree in a temperate climate adds a new layer of wood beneath its bark.
These layers appear as rings when the trunk is cut, and their width depends on the growing conditions of that year.
Wide rings indicate warm, wet years, while narrow rings reflect drought or cold.
By matching the patterns in living trees with those in old timber, scientists have built continuous records stretching back thousands of years.
missing: Such records allow archaeologists to date wooden objects and buildings to the exact year in which the tree was cut.
why: 'Such records' (bu tür kayıtlar) ifadesi 4. cümledeki binlerce yıla uzanan kesintisiz kayıtlara işaret eder. Kayıtlar ancak 4. cümlede oluşturulduğu için eksik cümle sona gelir.
tr: Bu tür kayıtlar, arkeologların ahşap nesneleri ve yapıları ağacın kesildiği yıla kadar kesin olarak tarihlendirmesini sağlar.

sentences: In a famous 1974 experiment, Elizabeth Loftus and John Palmer showed participants a film of a car accident.
Those who heard the more violent verb estimated much higher speeds.
A week later, they were also more likely to report having seen broken glass, although there was none in the film.
Such findings show that memory is not a recording but a reconstruction that can be altered by the wording of a question.
missing: Afterwards, some were asked how fast the cars were going when they 'hit' each other, while others heard the word 'smashed'.
why: 2. cümledeki 'the more violent verb' (daha şiddetli fiil) ifadesi, iki fiilin önceden karşılaştırılmasını gerektirir. 'hit' ve 'smashed' yalnızca eksik cümlede geçer.
tr: Ardından bazı katılımcılara arabaların birbirine 'çarptığında' ne kadar hızlı gittikleri soruldu, diğerleri ise soruda 'paramparça etti' fiilini duydu.

sentences: The Inca Empire governed millions of people across the Andes without a written language.
Instead, officials recorded information on quipus, bundles of colored cotton cords tied with knots.
In this way, administrators could keep track of taxes, population counts, and the contents of storehouses.
Some researchers suspect that certain quipus also recorded stories, though no one has yet deciphered them.
missing: The type and position of each knot represented a number in a decimal system.
why: Eksik cümle, 2. cümlede tanıtılan düğümlerin nasıl bilgi taşıdığını açıklar (onluk sistemde sayılar). 4. cümledeki 'also recorded stories' (hikâye de kaydetmiş olabilir) ifadesi de önce sayıların kaydedildiğinin söylenmesini bekler.
tr: Her düğümün türü ve konumu, onluk sistemde bir sayıyı temsil ediyordu.

sentences: Many astronauts report a profound change in outlook after seeing the Earth from space.
From orbit, they explain, the planet appears as a small, fragile sphere with a paper-thin atmosphere.
National borders, which seem so important on the ground, are invisible.
According to his interviews, many astronauts returned with a stronger sense of responsibility for protecting the planet.
missing: The writer Frank White named this experience the overview effect in 1987.
why: 4. cümledeki 'his interviews' (onun görüşmeleri) ifadesi tek bir kişinin önceden anılmasını gerektirir: eksik cümledeki yazar Frank White. 1 ve 2. cümleler 'they explain' ile birbirine bağlı olduğundan eksik cümle aralarına giremez.
tr: Yazar Frank White, 1987'de bu deneyime 'genel bakış etkisi' adını verdi.

sentences: At altitudes above four thousand meters, the air contains about forty percent less oxygen than at sea level.
Tibetans, by contrast, maintain normal levels of red blood cells even after living on the plateau for generations.
Researchers traced this difference to a variant of a gene called EPAS1, which regulates the body's response to low oxygen.
Remarkably, the variant appears to have been inherited from the Denisovans, an extinct group of ancient humans.
missing: Most lowland visitors respond by producing extra red blood cells, which thickens their blood and strains the heart.
why: 2. cümledeki 'by contrast' (buna karşılık) Tibetlileri başka bir grupla karşılaştırır. Bu grup, eksik cümledeki fazla alyuvar üreten ova insanlarıdır. 3. cümledeki 'this difference' (bu fark) da iki grubun karşılaştırılmasına dayanır.
tr: Ovadan gelen ziyaretçilerin çoğu fazladan alyuvar üreterek tepki verir; bu da kanlarını koyulaştırır ve kalbi zorlar.

sentences: Computer engineering labs are developing a new type of biological computer that processes data using synthetic DNA strands.
These microscopic storage pools can archive massive libraries of historical records in a tiny vial of liquid.
Consequently, this molecular technology could solve the global data storage crisis within the coming decades.
Furthermore, DNA-based storage requires absolutely no electrical power to preserve information over thousands of years.
missing: These biological systems utilize chemical bonds rather than traditional electronic switches to store binary information.
why: 'These biological systems' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen biyolojik bilgisayar ve sentetik DNA sarmalları teknolojisine işaret eder.
tr: Bu biyolojik sistemler, ikili (binary) bilgileri depolamak için geleneksel elektronik anahtarlar yerine kimyasal bağları kullanır.

sentences: Environmental scientists have engineered artificial soil mixtures designed to accelerate plant growth in degraded drylands.
They absorb rainwater during wet periods and release it slowly during intense summer heat.
This water-retention mechanism allows young plants to survive prolonged droughts without requiring manual watering.
Consequently, reforestation groups can restore barren hillsides far more efficiently than standard planting methods.
missing: These specialized chemical compounds are constructed from biodegradable superabsorbent polymers.
why: 'These specialized chemical compounds' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen yapay toprak karışımlarını işaret eder.
tr: Bu özel kimyasal bileşikler, biyolojik olarak parçalanabilen süper emici polimerlerden üretilmiştir.

sentences: Internet companies are deploying high-altitude balloons to deliver high-speed wireless connectivity to remote mountain communities.
These automated balloons fly in the stratosphere to avoid commercial air traffic and weather systems.
They receive signals from ground stations and transmit them directly to rural homes and schools.
Therefore, local students can access modern online educational resources without expensive infrastructure investments.
missing: This strategic elevation allows each transmitter to cover thousands of square kilometers of territory.
why: 'This strategic elevation' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen balonların stratosferde uçurulması eylemine işaret eder.
tr: Bu stratejik yükseklik, her bir vericinin binlerce kilometrekarelik bir alanı kapsamasını sağlar.

sentences: Materials scientists have designed a lightweight carbon-fiber armor that can absorb high-velocity physical impacts.
The unique material features a microscopic hexagonal structure inspired by the shells of deep-sea mollusks.
When impacted, these tiny hexagons bend slightly and distribute the physical energy across a wide area.
Consequently, the armor provides superior protection for law enforcement officers while remaining highly flexible.
missing: Such protective gear is significantly lighter than traditional steel or ceramic chest plates.
why: 'Such protective gear' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen hafif karbon fiber zırhı ve onun sağladığı üstün korumayı işaret eder.
tr: Bu tür koruyucu donanımlar, geleneksel çelik veya seramik göğüs plakalarından önemli ölçüde daha hafiftir.

sentences: Automotive engineers are testing solid-state batteries as a safer and more efficient alternative to lithium-ion cells.
These solid components eliminate the risk of short circuits and thermal runaway in electric cars.
This safety improvement allows manufacturers to pack more energy into the same battery volume.
Consequently, electric vehicles can travel much longer distances on a single charge than current models.
missing: These advanced batteries utilize a solid ceramic electrolyte rather than highly flammable liquid chemicals.
why: 'These advanced batteries' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen katı hal pillerini (solid-state batteries) işaret eder.
tr: Bu gelişmiş piller, son derece yanıcı sıvı kimyasallar yerine katı seramik bir elektrolit kullanır.

sentences: Biomedical engineers have developed microscopic robotic capsules that can perform internal biopsies without surgical incisions.
Equipped with tiny mechanical claws, the capsule harvests a small tissue sample from the stomach wall.
This localized sampling avoids the need for general anesthesia and reduces recovery times significantly.
Therefore, patients can undergo routine cancer screenings with much less discomfort and anxiety.
missing: These smart devices are swallowed easily by the patient and guided magnetically by the doctor.
why: 'These smart devices' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen mikroskobik robotik kapsülleri işaret eder.
tr: Bu akıllı cihazlar hasta tarafından kolayca yutulur ve doktor tarafından manyetik olarak yönlendirilir.

sentences: Artificial intelligence researchers are developing machine learning algorithms that can detect early signs of crop diseases.
The software analyzes high-resolution drone photos of fields to find microscopic spots on plant leaves.
These colored patterns indicate the presence of specific fungal pathogens before symptoms become visible.
Consequently, farmers can apply targeted organic treatments to save crops before the disease spreads widely.
missing: Such visual clues allow the computer system to classify the infection with high accuracy.
why: 'Such visual clues' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen yapraklar üzerindeki mikroskobik lekeleri işaret eder.
tr: Bu tür görsel ipuçları, bilgisayar sisteminin enfeksiyonu yüksek doğrulukla sınıflandırmasını sağlar.

sentences: Aerospace companies are testing supersonic commercial passenger airplanes designed to reduce global travel times significantly.
These high-speed aircraft utilize specialized engine designs that minimize the loud sound of sonic booms.
This noise reduction makes the airplanes compliant with strict international noise regulations over land.
Consequently, business travelers can fly across major international oceans in less than four hours.
missing: Furthermore, they utilize synthetic aviation fuels to minimize the environmental impact of high-altitude emissions.
why: 'Furthermore' bağlacı ve 'they' zamiri, bir önceki cümlede geçen uçakların hız ve gürültü azaltma özelliklerine ek olarak çevre dostu yakıt kullanımını ekler.
tr: Ayrıca, yüksek irtifa emisyonlarının çevresel etkisini en aza indirmek için sentetik havacılık yakıtları kullanırlar.

sentences: Materials scientists are developing self-cleaning window glass that uses solar energy to break down organic dirt.
They utilize ultraviolet rays to trigger a chemical reaction that decomposes stubborn dirt particles.
This chemical breakdown allows rainwater to wash away the residue easily without leaving any spots.
Consequently, building owners can reduce high window-cleaning maintenance costs for modern tall skyscrapers.
missing: These specialized panes are coated with a thin layer of titanium dioxide nanoparticles.
why: 'These specialized panes' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen kendi kendini temizleyen pencere camlarını işaret eder.
tr: Bu özel camlar, ince bir titanyum dioksit nanopartikül tabakası ile kaplanmıştır.

sentences: Telescope engineers are designing massive ground-based observatories equipped with advanced adaptive optics technology.
This rapid correction neutralizes the blurring effect caused by the turbulent Earth atmosphere.
Consequently, ground-based telescopes can capture images with a resolution comparable to space observatories.
Therefore, astronomers can observe distant planets orbiting nearby stars with unprecedented visual clarity.
missing: These dynamic mirrors adjust their shape thousands of times per second using computer-controlled actuators.
why: 'These dynamic mirrors' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen gelişmiş adaptif optik teknolojisini ve onun parçası olan hareketli aynaları işaret eder.
tr: Bu dinamik aynalar, bilgisayar kontrollü aktüatörler kullanarak saniyede binlerce kez şekillerini ayarlar.

sentences: Archaeologists working in southern Europe have discovered a massive prehistoric bronze-casting workshop.
The site contains numerous clay molds, smelting furnaces, and fragments of bronze axes.
These metal items were used for farming, woodcarving, and defensive warfare across the region.
Therefore, this discovery demonstrates the presence of highly specialized craftsmen in Bronze Age Europe.
missing: Such ancient tools allowed early farming communities to clear thick forests far more quickly.
why: 'Such ancient tools' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen tunç baltaları işaret eder.
tr: Bu tür antik aletler, ilk tarım topluluklarının yoğun ormanları çok daha hızlı temizlemesine olanak tanıdı.

sentences: The decipherment of the ancient Mayan hieroglyphic script has transformed our understanding of Mesoamerican history.
Scholars spent decades analyzing stone monuments, painted pottery vessels, and rare bark-paper books.
These written sources contain detailed records of royal dynasties, military conquests, and religious rituals.
Consequently, historians can now construct a precise political history of major Mayan city-states.
missing: Furthermore, they describe sophisticated astronomical calculations and calendar systems used by Mayan priests.
why: 'Furthermore' bağlacı ve 'they' zamiri, bir önceki cümlede geçen yazılı kaynakların siyasi tarih ve hanedan kayıtlarına ek olarak astronomik hesaplamaları da açıklamasını bağlar.
tr: Ayrıca, Maya rahipleri tarafından kullanılan gelişmiş astronomik hesaplamaları ve takvim sistemlerini tasvir ederler.

sentences: Archaeologists exploring a Neolithic village have uncovered the remains of primitive ceramic water pipes.
These underground channels redirected water from nearby mountain springs directly into residential areas.
This clean water supply helped prevent waterborne diseases and supported a growing population.
Consequently, this discovery suggests that early municipal sanitary engineering was much more advanced than assumed.
missing: These clay tubes were designed with interlocking ends to prevent leaks along the pipeline.
why: 'These clay tubes' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen ilkel seramik su borularını işaret eder.
tr: Bu kil borular, boru hattı boyunca sızıntıları önlemek için iç içe geçen uçlarla tasarlanmıştı.

sentences: Historians studying the commercial networks of the ancient Mediterranean are re-evaluating the role of shipwreck sites.
These underwater sites contain thousands of clay jars filled with olive oil and wine.
This commercial evidence demonstrates that merchant ships traveled long distances along established maritime routes.
Consequently, the ancient Mediterranean economy was highly integrated and dependent on international maritime trade.
missing: These preserved cargoes represent the actual goods traded among diverse ancient civilizations.
why: 'These preserved cargoes' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen zeytinyağı ve şarapla dolu kil küpleri işaret eder.
tr: Bu korunmuş kargolar, çeşitli antik medeniyetler arasında ticareti yapılan gerçek malları temsil etmektedir.

sentences: Louis Braille lost his sight at the age of three after an accident in his father's workshop.
At his school for blind children in Paris, students read books printed with large raised letters, which were slow to read and expensive to produce.
The fifteen-year-old Braille simplified this code, reducing each letter to a pattern of no more than six dots.
His system proved so efficient that it is still used around the world almost two centuries later.
missing: In 1821, a French army captain visited the school to demonstrate 'night writing', a code of raised dots that soldiers could read in the dark.
why: 3. cümledeki 'this code' (bu kod) ifadesi bir kodun önceden tanıtılmasını gerektirir. 2. cümledeki kabartma harfler bir kod değildir; kod, eksik cümledeki askerî 'gece yazısı'dır.
tr: 1821'de Fransız bir yüzbaşı okula gelerek askerlerin karanlıkta okuyabildiği kabartma noktalardan oluşan bir kodu, 'gece yazısı'nı tanıttı.

sentences: The trade of natural amber during the Bronze Age provides clear evidence of long-distance European trade networks.
This fossilized resin was highly valued for its beautiful golden color and organic properties.
Archaeologists have found Baltic amber ornaments in royal graves throughout the southern Mediterranean regions.
Consequently, northern and southern European communities must have maintained stable trade connections for centuries.
missing: Moreover, they utilized well-established overland paths through mountain passes to transport these items.
why: 'Moreover' bağlacı ve 'they' zamiri, bir önceki cümlede geçen toplulukların ticaret bağlantıları sürdürmelerine ek olarak kara yollarını kullanmalarını ekler.
tr: Dahası, bu eşyaları taşımak için dağ geçitlerinden geçen, iyi kurulmuş kara yollarını kullandılar.

sentences: The construction of the ancient city of Pompeii required sophisticated municipal planning to support its residents.
These ancient engineers built public baths, paved streets, and a complex water delivery system.
They redirected clean spring water into public fountains located at major street intersections.
Consequently, residents could access water easily, enhancing the overall public hygiene of the city.
missing: These skilled builders designed a grid system that organized residential and commercial zones efficiently.
why: 'These skilled builders' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen Pompeii kentinin belediye planlama ekiplerini ve mühendislerini işaret eder.
tr: Bu yetenekli yapıcılar, konut ve ticaret alanlarını verimli bir şekilde organize eden bir ızgara sistemi tasarlamışlardır.

sentences: Archaeologists have used LiDAR technology to map a massive ancient city hidden beneath the Guatemalan rainforest.
This advanced radar penetrated the dense forest canopy to reveal thousands of agricultural terraces.
This farming infrastructure supported a population that was much larger than historians previously believed.
Consequently, this discovery rewritten the history of Mayan agricultural capacity and urban planning.
missing: These newly discovered structures were completely invisible to researchers walking on the forest floor.
why: 'These newly discovered structures' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen tarım teraslarını işaret eder.
tr: Yeni keşfedilen bu yapılar, orman tabanında yürüyen araştırmacılar için tamamen görünmez durumdaydı.

sentences: Coastal wetlands provide crucial ecosystem services by protecting inland regions from severe ocean flooding.
They absorb high-energy waves during hurricanes and slow down the movement of storm surges.
These natural buffers prevent the erosion of shorelines and protect coastal infrastructure from destruction.
Therefore, environmental groups are advocating for the strict conservation of these coastal ecosystems.
missing: Such protective barriers reduce the financial damage caused by extreme weather events significantly.
why: 'Such protective barriers' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen kıyı sulak alanlarının dalgaları ve fırtına dalgalanmalarını emen doğal tampon özelliğine işaret eder.
tr: Bu tür koruyucu bariyerler, uç hava olaylarının neden olduğu finansal hasarı önemli ölçüde azaltır.

sentences: Invasive plant species can devastate local ecosystems by outcompeting native vegetation for light and nutrients.
They grow rapidly and cover large areas, preventing native seeds from receiving sunlight.
Without native plants, local insects and birds lose their primary food sources and nesting habitats.
Consequently, biodiversity decreases dramatically and entire local food webs face potential collapse.
missing: Furthermore, they can alter soil chemistry to make it toxic for other plant species.
why: 'Furthermore' bağlacı ve 'they' zamiri, bir önceki cümlede geçen istilacı bitkilerin böceklerin ve kuşların besin kaynaklarını yok etmesine ek olarak toprak kimyasını değiştirme zararını ekler.
tr: Ayrıca, toprağın kimyasını diğer bitki türleri için zehirli olacak şekilde değiştirebilirler.

sentences: Urban forestry programs are being implemented in major cities to combat the growing urban heat island effect.
These strategic plantings cool the surrounding air through shading and the process of evapotranspiration.
This natural cooling reduces the demand for air conditioning during hot summer periods.
Therefore, municipal governments are allocating large budgets to plant native tree species along streets.
missing: These green initiatives involve planting thousands of trees in densely populated metropolitan areas.
why: 'These green initiatives' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen kentsel ormancılık programlarını işaret eder.
tr: Bu yeşil girişimler, yoğun nüfuslu metropolitan alanlara binlerce ağaç dikilmesini içerir.

sentences: The melting of polar glaciers is accelerating due to rising global temperatures in recent decades.
This massive runoff contributes directly to the global rise in ocean sea levels.
This watery encroachment threatens coastal cities with frequent flooding and severe beach erosion.
Consequently, local governments are building expensive seawalls and reinforcing coastal defenses immediately.
missing: These melting ice sheets release billions of tons of fresh water into the oceans annually.
why: 'These melting ice sheets' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen kutup buzullarının erimesi durumuna işaret eder.
tr: Bu eriyen buzul örtüleri, okyanuslara yılda milyarlarca ton tatlı su bırakır.

sentences: Overfishing is a major environmental threat that depletes commercial fish populations across the globe.
Modern industrial fishing fleets use advanced sonar systems to track and capture entire schools of fish.
This intense pressure prevents fish populations from reproducing and recovering to sustainable levels.
Therefore, marine conservation groups are advocating for strict catch limits and protected marine zones.
missing: Such high efficiency leaves very few adult individuals to sustain the next generation.
why: 'Such high efficiency' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen gelişmiş sonar sistemleri kullanan modern balıkçılık filolarının verimliliğine işaret eder.
tr: Bu tür yüksek verimlilik, gelecek nesli sürdürecek çok az yetişkin birey bırakmaktadır.

sentences: Soil erosion is a severe agricultural problem caused by deforestation, overgrazing, and intensive tillage practices.
Without plant roots to stabilize the ground, heavy wind and rain wash away the fertile topsoil.
This fertility loss reduces crop yields and threatens food security in vulnerable dry regions.
Consequently, farmers are adopting conservation tillage methods to protect their agricultural soils.
missing: Furthermore, they can cause destructive sedimentation in nearby freshwater rivers, damaging aquatic habitats.
why: 'Furthermore' bağlacı ve 'they' zamiri, bir önceki cümlede geçen toprak erozyonunun tarımsal verimi düşürmesine ek olarak nehirlerde sedimentasyona yol açma zararını ekler.
tr: Ayrıca, yakındaki tatlı su nehirlerinde yıkıcı çökelmelere neden olarak sucul habitatlara zarar verebilirler.

sentences: In August 1883, the volcanic island of Krakatoa in Indonesia exploded with extraordinary force.
The final blast was heard nearly five thousand kilometers away on the island of Rodrigues in the Indian Ocean.
Barometers around the world recorded the pressure wave as it circled the planet several times.
The eruption also triggered tsunamis that killed more than thirty thousand people on nearby coasts.
missing: The effects did not end there, as ash in the upper atmosphere produced vivid red sunsets around the world for years afterwards.
why: 'The effects did not end there' (etkiler bununla bitmedi) ifadesi, patlamanın sonuçları sayıldıktan sonra gelir. Sayım 4. cümledeki 'also' (ayrıca) ile tsunamilerde sürer, eksik cümle de yıllarca süren etkiyle paragrafı kapatır.
tr: Etkiler bununla da bitmedi; üst atmosferdeki kül, sonraki yıllarda dünyanın dört bir yanında parlak kızıl gün batımlarına yol açtı.

sentences: The rapid decline of global bee populations is causing serious concern among agricultural scientists.
They visit millions of flowers daily while collecting pollen and nectar for their colonies.
This vital service supports agricultural productivity and maintains plant biodiversity in natural ecosystems.
Therefore, governments are restricting harmful pesticides and promoting wildflower habitats to save these species.
missing: These insect pollinators are responsible for fertilizing a large share of the crops that feed humanity.
why: 'These insect pollinators' ifadesi ve bir sonraki cümlede yer alan 'They' zamiri, bir önceki cümlede geçen arı popülasyonlarını işaret eder.
tr: Bu böcek polen taşıyıcıları, insanlığı besleyen mahsullerin büyük bir kısmının döllenmesinden sorumludur.

sentences: Cardiovascular diseases remain a leading cause of death globally, prompting research into preventative lifestyle factors.
Medical professionals recommend adopting regional eating habits like a Mediterranean diet to protect heart health.
This nutrient-rich diet reduces cholesterol levels and decreases the risk of arterial plaque formation.
Therefore, individuals can protect their circulatory systems by making simple changes to their daily meals.
missing: Such dietary changes are rich in healthy monounsaturated fats, fresh vegetables, and lean proteins.
why: 'Such dietary changes' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen Akdeniz diyeti gibi bölgesel beslenme alışkanlıklarını benimseme durumuna işaret eder.
tr: Bu tür diyet değişiklikleri; sağlıklı tekli doymamış yağlar, taze sebzeler ve yağsız proteinler açısından zengindir.

sentences: Telemedicine applications have expanded rapidly in recent decades, offering patients remote access to medical care.
These digital services utilize secure cloud databases to store and share patient records.
This convenient alternative reduces travel costs and waiting times for patients living in rural areas.
Consequently, remote healthcare systems are becoming an essential component of modern public health infrastructure.
missing: These online platforms allow individuals to consult specialized doctors via video calls.
why: 'These online platforms' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen teletıp uygulamalarını işaret eder.
tr: Bu çevrimiçi platformlar, bireylerin uzman doktorlarla görüntülü görüşmeler yoluyla konsültasyon yapmasına olanak tanır.

sentences: Chronic stress triggers the release of cortisol, a hormone that can impair various bodily systems over time.
High levels of cortisol suppress the immune system, making individuals more susceptible to infections.
This hormonal imbalance can also disrupt sleep patterns and increase the risk of cardiovascular diseases.
Therefore, stress-reduction techniques like meditation and regular exercise are recommended for maintaining physical health.
missing: Such biological effects demonstrate how mental stress can directly translate into physical illness.
why: 'Such biological effects' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen yüksek kortizol seviyelerinin bağışıklık sistemini baskılaması durumuna işaret eder.
tr: Bu tür biyolojik etkiler, zihinsel stresin nasıl doğrudan fiziksel hastalığa dönüşebileceğini göstermektedir.

sentences: The development of mRNA vaccine technology has revolutionized how scientists respond to infectious diseases.
These vaccines instruct human cells to produce a harmless viral protein that triggers an immune response.
The body learns to recognize the pathogen and develops protective antibodies without causing actual illness.
Consequently, this flexible platform allows researchers to design and manufacture new vaccines in record time.
missing: This molecular defense system ensures that the individual remains immune during future exposures.
why: 'This molecular defense system' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen antikorların geliştirilmesi ve patojenin tanınması sürecine işaret eder.
tr: Bu moleküler savunma sistemi, bireyin gelecekteki maruziyetler sırasında bağışık kalmasını sağlar.

sentences: In the 1890s, the Russian physiologist Ivan Pavlov was studying digestion in dogs.
He soon noticed that this measurement was being spoiled, because the dogs began to salivate before the food arrived.
Merely seeing the assistant who usually fed them was enough to trigger the response.
Pavlov realized that this was a learned reflex, and his investigation of it laid the foundations of behavioral psychology.
missing: To measure their saliva, he fed them meat powder and collected the fluid through small tubes.
why: 2. cümledeki 'this measurement' (bu ölçüm) ifadesi bir ölçümün önceden anlatılmasını gerektirir. Tükürüğün tüplerle toplanarak ölçülmesi yalnızca eksik cümlededir.
tr: Tükürüklerini ölçmek için onlara et tozu yediriyor ve sıvıyı küçük tüplerle topluyordu.

sentences: Almost every banana sold in supermarkets around the world belongs to a single variety called the Cavendish.
Because commercial bananas are seedless, new plants are grown from cuttings, making each one a genetic clone of the others.
Exactly this happened in the 1950s to the Gros Michel, the variety that dominated the market before the Cavendish.
Today, a new strain of the same fungal disease is spreading across banana plantations, and no resistant replacement is yet available.
missing: This lack of genetic diversity means that a disease able to kill one plant can kill them all.
why: 3. cümledeki 'Exactly this happened' (tam da bu oldu) ifadesi, önce bir olasılığın söylenmesini gerektirir: tek bir hastalığın hepsini öldürebilmesi. 'This lack of genetic diversity' (bu genetik çeşitlilik eksikliği) de 2. cümledeki klon bilgisine atıf yapar.
tr: Bu genetik çeşitlilik eksikliği, tek bir bitkiyi öldürebilen bir hastalığın hepsini öldürebileceği anlamına gelir.

sentences: In 1991, two hikers in the Alps discovered a frozen body emerging from a melting glacier.
Scientists soon determined that the man, nicknamed Otzi, had died more than five thousand years ago.
His clothing, tools, and even the contents of his stomach were remarkably well preserved.
For years, researchers assumed that he had died of cold and exhaustion during a storm.
missing: In 2001, however, an X-ray revealed a stone arrowhead lodged in his shoulder, showing that he had been murdered.
why: 'however' (ancak) 4. cümledeki 'soğuk ve yorgunluktan öldü' varsayımını çürütür. Varsayım ancak 4. cümlede dile getirildiği için eksik cümle sona gelir.
tr: Ancak 2001'de çekilen bir röntgen, omzuna saplanmış taş bir ok ucunu ortaya çıkardı ve onun öldürüldüğünü gösterdi.

sentences: The sharing economy has transformed consumer habits by prioritizing access to goods over individual ownership.
These peer-to-peer platforms match private owners of underutilized assets with individuals who need them.
This economic transaction allows both parties to save money and reduce their carbon footprint.
Consequently, traditional industries like car rentals and hotel chains are adapting to this competitive market.
missing: Such shared resources reduce the demand for manufacturing new physical products continuously.
why: 'Such shared resources' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen iki tarafın para tasarrufu yapmasını ve karbon ayak izini azaltmasını sağlayan varlık paylaşımı işlemine işaret eder.
tr: Bu tür paylaşılan kaynaklar, sürekli olarak yeni fiziksel ürünler üretme talebini azaltır.

sentences: Rapid urbanization in developing countries has created a critical need for efficient mass transit infrastructure.
Local authorities are investing heavily in rapid transit buses and modern subway lines.
These massive networks connect distant suburban residential zones with metropolitan commercial centers.
This structural development reduces traffic congestion and lowers greenhouse gas emissions from private cars.
missing: Therefore, these transit networks are essential for maintaining the economic productivity of growing cities.
why: 'Therefore' bağlacı ve 'these transit networks' ifadesi, bir önceki cümlede geçen altyapı gelişiminin trafik tıkanıklığını ve emisyonları azaltması durumunun sonucunu açıklar.
tr: Bu nedenle, bu ulaşım ağları, büyüyen şehirlerin ekonomik üretkenliğini sürdürmek için elzemdir.

sentences: Gentrification in historical urban areas often leads to displacement of lower-income families and local businesses.
These affluent newcomers buy old properties and invest heavily in their aesthetic renovation.
This economic pressure forces original inhabitants to relocate to cheaper suburbs far from the city.
Consequently, the cultural diversity and social cohesion of the neighborhood are permanently altered.
missing: These wealthy residents drive up property values, rental prices, and local municipal taxes.
why: 'These wealthy residents' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen düşük gelirli ailelerin yerinden edilmesine yol açan soylulaştırma sürecindeki varlıklı kişilere işaret eder.
tr: Bu varlıklı sakinler; mülk değerlerini, kira fiyatlarını ve yerel belediye vergilerini yükseltir.

sentences: Symphony orchestras are incorporating virtual reality technology to engage younger audiences in classical music.
These interactive headsets provide a three-dimensional perspective of the musical performance.
This immersive experience makes classical music more accessible and exciting for digital-native generations.
Therefore, major cultural institutions are investing in high-definition video recordings for virtual platforms.
missing: They allow viewers to stand on stage next to the musicians and watch the conductor.
why: 'They' zamiri bir önceki cümlede geçen etkileşimli sanal gerçeklik gözlüklerini (interactive headsets) işaret eder.
tr: İzleyicilerin sahnede müzisyenlerin yanında durmalarına ve şefi izlemelerine olanak tanırlar.

sentences: Street art has evolved from an underground subculture into a highly celebrated public art form.
Municipal governments now commission prominent artists to paint massive murals on public buildings.
These monumental works celebrate local history, social justice themes, and diverse cultural identities.
Consequently, city councils are establishing legal street art zones to encourage creative expression.
missing: Such creative projects also revitalize neglected urban neighborhoods, attracting tourists and art enthusiasts.
why: 'Such creative projects' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen kamu binaları üzerine boyanan anıtsal duvar resimlerini işaret eder.
tr: Bu tür yaratıcı projeler aynı zamanda ihmal edilmiş kentsel mahalleleri canlandırarak turistleri ve sanat meraklılarını çeker.

sentences: Art museums are utilizing advanced non-destructive chemical analysis to verify the authenticity of classical paintings.
Specialists use X-ray fluorescence and infrared spectroscopy to analyze pigments without touching the surface.
Such analytical techniques can detect modern synthetic pigments hidden beneath old layers of paint.
These chemical signatures reveal whether the materials used correspond to the artist's historical era.
missing: Consequently, museums can identify forged artworks and protect their valuable collections with absolute certainty.
why: 'Consequently' bağlacı ve 'these chemical signatures' ifadesi, bir önceki cümlede geçen kimyasal imzaların malzemenin doğruluğunu ortaya çıkarması durumunun sonucunu bağlar.
tr: Sonuç olarak, müzeler sahte sanat eserlerini tespit edebilir ve değerli koleksiyonlarını kesin bir güvenlikle koruyabilir.

sentences: Computer scientists have developed neuromorphic microprocessors that mimic the biological structure of the human brain.
They process and store information at the same physical locations, imitating the function of biological synapses.
This unique architecture eliminates the traditional communication delay between processing units and memory systems.
Consequently, compact mobile devices can perform complex machine learning calculations locally without internet access.
missing: These biological microprocessors require much less electrical energy than traditional silicon-based computing chips.
why: 'These biological microprocessors' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen nöromorfik mikroişlemcileri işaret eder.
tr: Bu biyolojik mikroişlemciler, geleneksel silikon tabanlı bilgisayar çiplerinden çok daha az elektrik enerjisi gerektirir.

sentences: Material scientists have engineered a self-cleaning plastic surface that repels water, oil, and bacterial cultures.
It features microscopic pillars and ridges that prevent droplets from adhering to the material surface.
This physical barrier prevents bacteria from multiplying and forming harmful biological films on the plastic.
Consequently, food packaging companies can use this hygienic material to extend the shelf life of meats.
missing: This unique texturing is inspired by the natural structure of lotus leaves and insect wings.
why: 'This unique texturing' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen mikroskobik sütunlar ve sırtlar gibi yüzey dokusuna işaret eder.
tr: Bu benzersiz doku, lotus yapraklarının ve böcek kanatlarının doğal yapısından ilham almıştır.

sentences: Internet technology companies are testing solar-powered gliders to deliver high-speed broadband connection to rural villages.
These autonomous aircraft are designed to remain aloft in the stratosphere for months at a time.
They utilize lightweight solar cells and high-efficiency batteries to power their communication equipment through the night.
Therefore, remote schools can participate in real-time interactive distance learning without expensive fiber optic networks.
missing: This continuous operation ensures stable coverage for areas without traditional telecommunication towers.
why: 'This continuous operation' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen otonom uçakların gece boyunca kesintisiz çalışması eylemine işaret eder.
tr: Bu sürekli çalışma, geleneksel telekomünikasyon kuleleri olmayan alanlar için istikrarlı bir kapsama alanı sağlar.

sentences: Mechanical engineers are developing soft bionic suits to assist warehouse workers in lifting heavy industrial loads.
These robotic structures utilize flexible textile materials and pressurized air actuators instead of rigid metal parts.
They monitor the physical movements of the user and provide extra mechanical force when lifting items.
Consequently, workers experience significantly less muscle strain and fatigue during long shifts.
missing: Such ergonomic benefits could reduce the rate of workplace back injuries in logistics centers.
why: 'Such ergonomic benefits' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen kas gerginliğinin ve yorgunluğunun azalması durumuna işaret eder.
tr: Bu tür ergonomik faydalar, lojistik merkezlerinde iş yeri kaynaklı sırt yaralanmalarının oranını azaltabilir.

sentences: Synthetic biologists have engineered specialized microorganisms capable of absorbing heavy metal contaminants from industrial wastewater.
These microscopic agents accumulate toxic chemical substances inside their cell walls without being harmed.
This biological filtering prevents toxic metals from entering local drinking water sources and agricultural fields.
Consequently, local authorities can restore contaminated industrial sites in a highly cost-effective manner.
missing: These biological systems can survive in highly acidic environments that would kill natural bacterial strains.
why: 'These biological systems' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen ağır metalleri emen özel mikroorganizmaları işaret eder.
tr: Bu biyolojik sistemler, doğal bakteri türlerini öldürecek son derece asidik ortamlarda hayatta kalabilir.

sentences: Agricultural technology companies are deploying autonomous weeding robots to reduce chemical herbicide usage on farms.
These electric machines utilize advanced computer vision to distinguish between crop plants and weeds.
This precise mechanical removal eliminates the need to spray toxic chemicals over entire agricultural fields.
Therefore, farmers can grow healthier organic produce while reducing the environmental impact of chemical runoff.
missing: They utilize tiny mechanical lasers to destroy weed seedlings without damaging nearby crops.
why: 'They' zamiri bir önceki cümlede geçen gelişmiş bilgisayarlı görü sistemiyle donatılmış elektrikli robotları işaret eder.
tr: Yakındaki ürünlere zarar vermeden yabani ot fidelerini yok etmek için küçük mekanik lazerler kullanırlar.

sentences: Materials scientists are developing ultra-thin solar cells that are flexible enough to be integrated into clothing.
These organic solar cells utilize lightweight polymers instead of heavy silicon crystals to generate electricity.
This physical flexibility allows manufacturers to weave the energy-harvesting materials directly into athletic shirts.
Consequently, hikers can charge their mobile devices while walking outdoors under sunlight.
missing: Such innovative fabrics can be bent and washed repeatedly without losing their electrical efficiency.
why: 'Such innovative fabrics' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen enerji toplayan malzemelerin doğrudan spor tişörtlerine dokunması durumuna işaret eder.
tr: Bu tür yenilikçi kumaşlar, elektriksel verimliliklerini kaybetmeden defalarca bükülebilir ve yıkanabilir.

sentences: Biomedical engineers are developing smart contact lenses that can monitor glucose levels in tear fluid continuously.
The lens contains a microscopic biosensor and an ultra-thin wireless transmitter integrated into its polymer body.
It measures blood sugar changes in real time and transmits the data to a mobile phone app.
Therefore, diabetic patients can monitor their condition without performing painful finger-prick blood tests.
missing: Furthermore, they do not interfere with normal vision or cause irritation to sensitive eyes.
why: 'Furthermore' bağlacı ve 'they' zamiri, bir önceki cümlede geçen kontakt lenslerin şeker ölçme işlevine ek olarak gözü tahriş etmeme ve görüşü engelleme özelliklerini ekler.
tr: Ayrıca, normal görüşü engellemezler veya hassas gözlerde tahrişe neden olmazlar.

sentences: Aviation engineers are testing electric propulsion systems for short-haul commercial passenger flights.
These electric aircraft utilize high-density battery packs to power multiple electric motors along the wings.
This clean engine design eliminates direct greenhouse gas emissions during the entire flight process.
Consequently, short-distance flights could become a highly sustainable alternative to passenger train travel.
missing: These modern prototypes are significantly quieter than traditional jet engines during take-off.
why: 'These modern prototypes' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen elektrikli uçuş/itki sistemlerini ve uçak modellerini işaret eder.
tr: Bu modern prototipler, kalkış sırasında geleneksel jet motorlarından önemli ölçüde daha sessizdir.

sentences: Software developers have designed an artificial intelligence system that can write computer code from simple descriptions.
These advanced algorithms analyze millions of lines of open-source software to learn coding patterns.
This rapid generation allows programmers to build software applications much faster than writing code manually.
Consequently, technology startups can reduce their development costs and launch products more quickly.
missing: They can automatically identify bugs in the code and suggest immediate corrections.
why: 'They' zamiri bir önceki cümlede geçen açık kaynak kodlu yazılımları analiz eden gelişmiş algoritmaları işaret eder.
tr: Kod içindeki hataları otomatik olarak tespit edebilir ve anında düzeltmeler önerebilirler.

sentences: Deep inside a mountain on the Arctic island of Spitsbergen lies a vault designed to protect the world's crops.
These samples are kept at minus eighteen degrees, and the surrounding permafrost keeps them frozen even if the power fails.
The vault proved its value sooner than expected.
In 2015, researchers whose gene bank near Aleppo had been damaged by the Syrian war withdrew seeds to rebuild their collection.
missing: Opened in 2008, the Svalbard Global Seed Vault stores backup copies of seeds from gene banks around the world.
why: 2. cümledeki 'These samples' (bu örnekler) ifadesi örneklerin önceden anılmasını gerektirir. Tohum kopyaları yalnızca eksik cümlede geçer. Eksik cümle 1. cümlede tanıtılan mahzene adını da verir.
tr: 2008'de açılan Svalbard Küresel Tohum Deposu, dünyanın dört bir yanındaki gen bankalarından gelen tohumların yedek kopyalarını saklar.

sentences: The dechipherment of the ancient Linear B script has transformed our understanding of Mycenaean Greece.
Scholars spent decades analyzing clay tablets containing administrative lists, tax records, and palace receipts.
These commercial records demonstrate that Myceanaean society had a highly centralized administrative bureaucracy.
Consequently, historians can now reconstruct the economic organization of early Aegean palace economies.
missing: Furthermore, they describe historical events and religious offerings from a local perspective.
why: 'Furthermore' bağlacı ve 'they' zamiri, bir önceki cümlede geçen ticari kayıtların idari ve mali bilgiler sunmasına ek olarak tarihi olayları ve sunuları açıklamasını bağlar.
tr: Ayrıca, tarihi olayları ve dini adakları yerel bir bakış açısıyla tasvir ederler.

sentences: Archaeologists exploring an ancient Roman villa have uncovered evidence of early medical surgical tools.
These ancient physicians apparently treated injured gladiators with remarkable anatomical knowledge and skill.
They used specialized bronze scalpels and bone drills to perform complex physical procedures.
Consequently, researchers believe that Roman military medicine was far more advanced than assumed.
missing: These skilled surgical practitioners utilized sterilized instruments to prevent infections during operations.
why: 'These skilled surgical practitioners' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen tıbbi cerrahi aletler kullanan antik hekimleri işaret eder.
tr: Bu yetenekli cerrahi uygulayıcılar, ameliyatlar sırasında enfeksiyonu önlemek için sterilize edilmiş aletler kullanmışlardır.

sentences: When the Hubble Space Telescope was launched in 1990, astronomers expected images of unprecedented sharpness.
The first pictures, however, were disappointingly blurry.
Since the mirror could not be replaced in orbit, engineers designed corrective optics that worked like a pair of glasses.
Astronauts installed them in 1993, and Hubble went on to produce some of the most famous images in the history of science.
missing: Investigators found that the main mirror had been ground to the wrong shape by an error smaller than a fiftieth of the width of a human hair.
why: 3. cümledeki 'the mirror could not be replaced' (ayna değiştirilemezdi) ifadesi aynada bir kusur bulunduğunun önceden söylenmesini gerektirir. Kusur eksik cümlededir; eksik cümle 2. cümledeki bulanıklığın sebebini açıklar.
tr: Araştırmacılar, ana aynanın insan saçının ellide birinden küçük bir hatayla yanlış biçimde taşlandığını buldu.

sentences: Many speed-reading courses promise that students can learn to read thousands of words per minute.
Reading speed, however, is limited by the way our eyes move across a page.
Rather than gliding smoothly, the eyes jump from word to word, pausing briefly on each one.
Studies show that readers who push far beyond about five hundred words per minute understand much less of what they read.
missing: Only during these pauses can the brain take in visual information clearly.
why: 'these pauses' (bu duraklamalar) ifadesi 3. cümledeki gözün her kelimede kısa süre durmasına işaret eder. Eksik cümle bu duraklamaların neden hızı sınırladığını açıklar; 4. cümle de bunun kanıtını verir.
tr: Beyin görsel bilgiyi ancak bu duraklamalar sırasında net biçimde alabilir.

sentences: Leafcutter ants can be seen carrying pieces of leaves many times their own weight back to their nests.
Surprisingly, the ants do not eat these leaves.
Instead, they chew them into a paste on which they grow a special fungus in underground gardens.
The fungus serves as the colony's only food, and the ants protect it from disease with antibiotics produced by bacteria living on their bodies.
missing: This partnership between insect, fungus, and bacteria has lasted for millions of years.
why: 'This partnership between insect, fungus, and bacteria' (böcek, mantar ve bakteri arasındaki bu ortaklık) ifadesi üç ortağın da anılmış olmasını gerektirir. Bakteriler ilk kez 4. cümlede geçtiği için eksik cümle sona gelir.
tr: Böcek, mantar ve bakteri arasındaki bu ortaklık milyonlarca yıldır sürüyor.

sentences: The construction of the ancient city of Ephesus required sophisticated municipal engineering to support its growing population.
These skilled engineers built monumental aqueducts, public baths, and an extensive underground sewer system.
They redirected freshwater from mountain springs into public fountains situated throughout the residential quarters.
Consequently, Ephesian citizens had reliable water access, which enhanced the overall public health of the city.
missing: These ancient planners designed a grid system that separated residential, commercial, and political zones efficiently.
why: 'These ancient planners' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen Efes kentindeki idari ekipleri ve mühendisleri işaret eder.
tr: Bu antik planlamacılar; konut, ticaret ve siyaset alanlarını verimli bir şekilde ayıran bir ızgara sistemi tasarlamışlardır.

sentences: Forest fires are usually seen as pure destruction, but some ecosystems actually depend on them.
The lodgepole pine of North America, for example, produces cones sealed shut with a thick resin.
These cones can hang on the tree for years without releasing their seeds.
Only the intense heat of a wildfire melts the resin and allows the cones to open.
missing: The seeds then fall onto ground that has been cleared of competing plants and enriched with ash.
why: 'then' (ardından) kozalakların açılmasından sonraki adımı anlatır. Açılma 4. cümlede gerçekleştiği için eksik cümle sona gelir ve yangının neden yararlı olduğunu gösterir.
tr: Tohumlar ardından rakip bitkilerden temizlenmiş ve külle zenginleşmiş toprağa düşer.

sentences: In 1993, a short study reported that students who listened to a Mozart sonata performed better on a spatial reasoning task.
Nevertheless, the media quickly turned the finding into the claim that classical music makes babies smarter.
The governor of Georgia even proposed giving a classical music CD to every newborn in the state.
Later studies concluded that the effect, where it appeared at all, was simply the result of being in a more alert and positive mood.
missing: The improvement was small and lasted only about fifteen minutes.
why: 2. cümledeki 'Nevertheless' (buna rağmen) ifadesi, bulgunun sınırlı olduğunu söyleyen bir bilgiyi gerektirir. Bu bilgi eksik cümlededir: gelişme küçüktü ve yalnızca on beş dakika sürdü.
tr: Gelişme küçüktü ve yalnızca on beş dakika kadar sürdü.

sentences: To obtain a license, London taxi drivers must memorize about twenty-five thousand streets and thousands of landmarks.
Preparing for this test, known as the Knowledge, typically takes three to four years.
The longer they had worked as taxi drivers, the larger this region tended to be.
The findings provided striking evidence that the adult brain can physically change in response to learning.
missing: In 2000, brain scans showed that experienced drivers had a larger posterior hippocampus, a region involved in spatial memory.
why: 3. cümledeki 'this region' (bu bölge) ifadesi bir beyin bölgesinin önceden anılmasını gerektirir. Hipokampus yalnızca eksik cümlede geçer.
tr: 2000 yılında yapılan beyin taramaları, deneyimli sürücülerde uzamsal bellekle ilgili bir bölge olan arka hipokampusun daha büyük olduğunu gösterdi.

sentences: Computer engineering teams have manufactured a prototype silicon microchip that operates at cryogenic temperatures.
They utilize superconducting metallic connections that experience zero electrical resistance when cooled properly.
This physical state prevents energy losses and allows signals to travel across the chip instantly.
Consequently, quantum computing centers can integrate these chips to manage complex processor arrays easily.
missing: These specialized systems require continuous liquid helium cooling to maintain their superb performance.
why: 'These specialized systems' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen kriyojenik sıcaklıklarda çalışan silikon mikroçip prototipini işaret eder.
tr: Bu özel sistemler, üstün performanslarını korumak için sürekli sıvı helyum soğutması gerektirir.

sentences: Material scientists have designed an elastic polymer skin that can detect changes in physical pressure and temperature.
This unique structure mimics the sensory functions of human skin with remarkable sensitivity.
This sensory feedback allows robotic hands to grip fragile glass cups without causing any damage.
Consequently, robotics companies can use this material to build more functional humanoid robots.
missing: These integrated sensors translate tactile touch and thermal energy into electronic signals.
why: 'These integrated sensors' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen fiziksel basınç ve sıcaklık değişimlerini algılayabilen esnek polimer deriyi ve onun duyusal işlevlerini işaret eder.
tr: Bu entegre sensörler, dokunsal teması ve termal enerjiyi elektronik sinyallere dönüştürür.

sentences: Aviation companies are testing fully automated air traffic control systems to manage busy urban drone deliveries.
These cloud-based platforms monitor thousands of flight paths simultaneously using real-time satellite coordination.
They calculate optimal collision-free routes and assign dedicated landing zones in crowded city environments.
Therefore, commercial delivery drones can transport packages safely without requiring constant manual supervision.
missing: This digital management prevents any dangerous aerial conflicts over populated municipal residential areas.
why: 'This digital management' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen bulut tabanlı platformların rotaları hesaplaması ve iniş bölgelerini ataması eylemine işaret eder.
tr: Bu dijital yönetim, nüfuslu belediye konut alanları üzerindeki her türlü tehlikeli hava çatışmasını önler.

sentences: Biomedical scientists are testing miniature organic capsules designed to deliver medications directly to tumor cells.
These smart capsules are coated with specialized proteins that recognize specific receptors on cancer cells.
This precise targeting allows the capsule to release its drug cargo only at the diseased site.
Consequently, healthy surrounding tissues are protected from the toxic effects of standard chemotherapy.
missing: Such targeted therapies could improve the overall survival rates of high-risk patients significantly.
why: 'Such targeted therapies' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen akıllı kapsüllerin sadece hastalıklı bölgede ilaç salınımı yapması yöntemine işaret eder.
tr: Bu tür hedefe yönelik tedaviler, yüksek riskli hastaların genel hayatta kalma oranlarını önemli ölçüde artırabilir.

sentences: Synthetic chemists have designed a highly efficient catalyst that can convert carbon dioxide into industrial alcohol.
These chemical processes can operate at room temperature without requiring high pressure or toxic solvents.
This clean synthesis offers a promising path for recycling industrial greenhouse gas emissions.
Consequently, chemical factories can reduce their reliance on petroleum-based raw materials in recent decades.
missing: These biological systems utilize abundant, cheap copper molecules to trigger the chemical transformation.
why: 'These biological systems' ifadesi bir önceki cümlede geçen karbondioksiti endüstriyel alkole dönüştüren yüksek verimli katalizörü işaret eder.
tr: Bu biyolojik sistemler, kimyasal dönüşümü tetiklemek için bol miktarda bulunan, ucuz bakır moleküllerini kullanır.

sentences: Agricultural engineering groups are testing autonomous weed-control lasers to reduce herbicide usage on organic farms.
These automated machines scan fields using high-resolution cameras and computer vision software.
This precise thermal elimination destroys weed seedlings without damaging the surrounding crops.
Therefore, farmers can maintain high crop quality while reducing the environmental impact of chemical runoff.
missing: They utilize intense, concentrated light beams to vaporize unwanted weeds in milliseconds.
why: 'They' zamiri bir önceki cümlede geçen otonom yabani ot kontrol lazerlerini ve bunların tarama sistemlerini işaret eder.
tr: İstenmeyen yabani otları milisaniyeler içinde buharlaştırmak için yoğun, konsantre ışık ışınları kullanırlar.

sentences: Spider silk is one of the most remarkable materials in nature.
Weight for weight, the dragline silk of some spiders is stronger than steel.
It is also highly elastic, stretching considerably before it breaks.
Farming spiders for their silk is impractical, however, because they are territorial and tend to eat one another.
missing: This combination of strength and flexibility allows a web to absorb the impact of a flying insect without tearing.
why: 'This combination of strength and flexibility' (sağlamlık ve esnekliğin bu birleşimi) ifadesi, iki özelliğin de söylenmiş olmasını gerektirir: sağlamlık 2. cümlede, esneklik 3. cümlede. Bu yüzden eksik cümle 3. cümleden sonra gelir.
tr: Sağlamlık ve esnekliğin bu birleşimi, bir ağın uçan bir böceğin çarpmasını yırtılmadan karşılamasını sağlar.

sentences: Software developers have built an artificial intelligence model that can translate regional sign languages in real time.
The software utilizes advanced motion-tracking algorithms to analyze hand shapes, facial expressions, and body gestures.
It translates these physical signs instantly into spoken words and displays them on a screen.
Therefore, deaf individuals can communicate easily with hearing people without requiring a human translator.
missing: Furthermore, they can adapt the translation model to support multiple regional sign languages.
why: 'Furthermore' bağlacı ve 'they' zamiri, bir önceki cümlede geçen yapay zeka yazılımının işaret dilini çevirme özelliğine ek olarak farklı bölgesel dilleri destekleme özelliğini ekler.
tr: Ayrıca, çeviri modelini birden fazla bölgesel işaret dilini destekleyecek şekilde uyarlayabilirler.

sentences: After the nuclear accident at Chernobyl in 1986, about 350,000 people were evacuated from the surrounding area.
Many scientists expected the abandoned zone to remain a lifeless wasteland for centuries.
Instead, surveys have found thriving populations of wolves, elk, wild boar, and even rare Przewalski's horses.
Radiation has certainly harmed individual animals, causing higher rates of mutations and cataracts in some species.
missing: For wildlife as a whole, however, the absence of humans seems to have been more beneficial than the radiation has been harmful.
why: 'however' (ancak) 4. cümledeki 'radyasyon tek tek hayvanlara zarar verdi' kabulünü dengeler. Zarar 4. cümlede kabul edildiği için genel değerlendirme sona gelir.
tr: Ancak yaban hayatı bir bütün olarak düşünüldüğünde, insanların yokluğu radyasyonun verdiği zarardan daha yararlı olmuş görünüyor.

sentences: In January 1610, Galileo Galilei pointed his newly built telescope at Jupiter.
Over the following nights, these points changed position, and a fourth one appeared.
Galileo concluded that they were moons orbiting Jupiter.
The discovery challenged the belief that everything in the heavens revolved around the Earth.
missing: Next to the planet, he noticed three small points of light lying in a straight line.
why: 2. cümledeki 'these points' (bu noktalar) ifadesi noktaların önceden anılmasını gerektirir. Üç küçük ışık noktası yalnızca eksik cümlede geçer.
tr: Gezegenin yanında, düz bir çizgi üzerinde duran üç küçük ışık noktası fark etti.

sentences: Monopoly is one of the best-selling board games in history.
Few players know, however, that it was based on a game invented in 1904 by an American woman named Lizzie Magie.
Ironically, the game that was meant to criticize monopolies later made a fortune for the company that sold it.
Magie herself received only about five hundred dollars for her patent.
missing: Her version, called The Landlord's Game, was designed to show how the concentration of land ownership impoverished tenants.
why: 3. cümledeki 'Ironically ... meant to criticize monopolies' (ironik biçimde tekelleri eleştirmek için yapılmıştı) ifadesi, oyunun eleştirel amacının önceden söylenmesini gerektirir. Bu amaç eksik cümlededir; 'Her version' da 2. cümledeki Lizzie Magie'ye atıf yapar.
tr: Onun 'Ev Sahibi Oyunu' adlı versiyonu, toprak mülkiyetinin yoğunlaşmasının kiracıları nasıl yoksullaştırdığını göstermek için tasarlanmıştı.

sentences: In 1887, a Polish eye doctor named Ludwik Zamenhof published the first book on a language he had invented.
Its grammar was designed to be simple, with sixteen basic rules and no irregular verbs.
Today, an estimated hundred thousand to two million people speak it, and some children even learn it from birth.
No country, however, has ever adopted it as an official language.
missing: He called it Esperanto and hoped that a shared, neutral language would promote peace between nations.
why: Eksik cümle, 1. cümlede icat edildiği söylenen dile adını verir ve amacını açıklar. 2. cümleden itibaren dilin özelliklerine geçilir; dilin adı ve amacı icattan hemen sonra gelmelidir.
tr: Ona Esperanto adını verdi ve ortak, tarafsız bir dilin uluslar arasında barışı güçlendireceğini umdu.

sentences: Antarctica is the only continent without a permanent human population.
During the first half of the twentieth century, seven countries claimed parts of it, and several of these claims overlapped.
The agreement froze all territorial claims and banned military activity on the continent.
It also declared Antarctica a place reserved for peaceful scientific research.
missing: To prevent these disputes from escalating during the Cold War, twelve nations signed the Antarctic Treaty in 1959.
why: 3. cümledeki 'The agreement' (anlaşma) ifadesi bir anlaşmanın önceden anılmasını gerektirir: eksik cümledeki Antarktika Antlaşması. 'these disputes' (bu anlaşmazlıklar) da 2. cümledeki çakışan toprak taleplerine işaret eder.
tr: Soğuk Savaş sırasında bu anlaşmazlıkların tırmanmasını önlemek için on iki ülke 1959'da Antarktika Antlaşması'nı imzaladı.

sentences: In a 1973 study, psychologists observed preschool children who enjoyed drawing during free play.
Some of the children were promised a certificate with a gold seal if they produced drawings.
Others drew without any expectation of a reward.
This decline suggests that external rewards can undermine the enjoyment people find in activities they once did for their own sake.
missing: When the researchers returned two weeks later, the rewarded children spent only about half as much time drawing as before.
why: 4. cümledeki 'This decline' (bu düşüş) ifadesi ölçülmüş bir düşüşü gerektirir. Ödül alan çocukların resim yapmaya ayırdığı sürenin yarıya inmesi yalnızca eksik cümlede verilir.
tr: Araştırmacılar iki hafta sonra geri döndüğünde, ödül alan çocukların resim yapmaya eskisinin yalnızca yarısı kadar zaman ayırdığını gördü.

sentences: The marathon is named after a legend from ancient Greece.
According to the story, a messenger ran from the town of Marathon to Athens to announce a victory over the Persians.
After delivering his message, he collapsed and died.
When the race was introduced at the first modern Olympics in 1896, it covered about forty kilometers.
missing: Its official distance of 42.195 kilometers comes from the 1908 London Olympics, where the course was arranged to finish in front of the royal box.
why: Eksik cümle, 4. cümledeki 1896'daki 'yaklaşık kırk kilometre' bilgisini bugünkü resmî mesafeyle tamamlar. Kronolojik olarak 1896'dan sonra, 1908'e gelir; modern yarıştan önce söz edilemez.
tr: Resmî 42,195 kilometrelik mesafesi, parkurun kraliyet locasının önünde bitecek şekilde düzenlendiği 1908 Londra Olimpiyatları'ndan gelir.

sentences: The giant panda is a striking evolutionary puzzle.
Because it can digest only a small fraction of this tough plant, a panda must eat for up to fourteen hours a day.
To save energy, it also moves slowly and spends much of the remaining time resting.
Scientists believe pandas switched to bamboo millions of years ago, when the plant offered an abundant food source with little competition.
missing: Its digestive system is that of a carnivore, yet bamboo makes up about ninety-nine percent of its diet.
why: 2. cümledeki 'this tough plant' (bu sert bitki) ifadesi bir bitkinin önceden anılmasını gerektirir: eksik cümledeki bambu. Eksik cümle 1. cümledeki 'bilmece'yi de açıklar: etçil sindirim ama bitkisel beslenme.
tr: Sindirim sistemi bir etçilinkidir, ancak beslenmesinin yaklaşık yüzde doksan dokuzunu bambu oluşturur.

sentences: Daylight saving time was first widely adopted during the First World War.
Germany introduced it in 1916, and many other countries soon followed.
Modern studies, however, suggest that the energy savings are very small.
Moreover, the switch in spring is associated with a brief increase in heart attacks and traffic accidents.
missing: The aim was to save coal by giving people more daylight in the evenings, when they would otherwise burn fuel for lighting.
why: 3. cümledeki 'however ... the energy savings are very small' (ancak enerji tasarrufu çok azdır) ifadesi, önce bir tasarruf amacının söylenmesini gerektirir. Bu amaç eksik cümledeki kömür tasarrufudur.
tr: Amaç, insanlara akşamları daha fazla gün ışığı sağlayarak aydınlatma için yakacakları kömürden tasarruf etmekti.

sentences: Most people have experienced the frustrating sensation of knowing a word but being unable to retrieve it.
Psychologists call this the tip-of-the-tongue state, and it becomes more frequent with age.
Interestingly, the elusive word is rarely lost completely during such moments.
Such fragments suggest that a word's meaning and its sound are stored in separate parts of memory.
missing: A speaker may recall, for instance, that the forgotten word begins with 'B' and has two syllables.
why: Eksik cümle, 3. cümledeki 'kelime tamamen kaybolmaz' iddiasına somut bir örnek verir (ilk harf, hece sayısı). 4. cümledeki 'Such fragments' (bu tür kırıntılar) ifadesi de ancak bu örnekten sonra anlam kazanır.
tr: Örneğin bir konuşmacı, unuttuğu kelimenin 'B' harfiyle başladığını ve iki heceli olduğunu hatırlayabilir.

sentences: Octopuses can change the color and texture of their skin in a fraction of a second.
Specialized cells called chromatophores expand or contract to produce these rapid displays.
Remarkably, scientists have found that most octopus species are colorblind.
One hypothesis holds that light-sensitive proteins in the skin itself may detect the surrounding colors.
missing: Yet the animals still match the colors of their surroundings with astonishing accuracy.
why: 'Yet' zıtlık kurar: 3. cümle ahtapotların renk körü olduğunu söyler, eksik cümle ise buna rağmen çevreye kusursuz uyum sağladıklarını belirtir. Bu çelişki, 4. cümledeki 'One hypothesis' (bir hipotez) açıklamasını gerektiren bilmecedir.
tr: Yine de bu hayvanlar çevrelerinin renklerine şaşırtıcı bir doğrulukla uyum sağlar.

sentences: In the 1840s, the Hungarian doctor Ignaz Semmelweis noticed an alarming pattern in a Vienna hospital.
Women whose babies were delivered by doctors died of fever far more often than those attended by midwives.
He realized that the doctors often came directly from performing autopsies.
Despite this evidence, his colleagues rejected the idea, and he died years later without receiving recognition.
missing: After he required staff to wash their hands in a chlorine solution, the death rate fell dramatically.
why: Kronolojik akış: 3. cümlede sebep fark edilir, eksik cümlede önlem alınır ve sonuç görülür. 4. cümledeki 'this evidence' (bu kanıt) ölüm oranının düşmesine işaret eder; otopsi bilgisi tek başına kanıt değildir.
tr: Personelin ellerini klorlu bir çözeltiyle yıkamasını zorunlu kılmasından sonra ölüm oranı çarpıcı biçimde düştü.

sentences: Anchoring is a cognitive bias in which people rely too heavily on the first number they encounter.
Remarkably, the effect persists even when the initial number is obviously irrelevant.
Those who landed on a high number gave much higher estimates than those who landed on a low one.
Negotiators therefore often benefit from making the first offer in a discussion about price.
missing: In one well-known experiment, participants spun a wheel of fortune before estimating the percentage of African nations in the United Nations.
why: 3. cümledeki 'Those who landed on a high number' (yüksek sayıya denk gelenler) bir çark deneyini gerektirir; bu deney ancak eksik cümlede anlatılır. Eksik cümle, 2. cümledeki 'alakasız sayı bile etkiler' iddiasının kanıtıdır.
tr: Ünlü bir deneyde katılımcılar, BM'deki Afrika ülkelerinin oranını tahmin etmeden önce bir şans çarkı çevirdi.

sentences: Limestone caves form when slightly acidic rainwater seeps through cracks in the rock.
As it moves downward, the water slowly dissolves the calcium carbonate that makes up limestone.
When this mineral-rich water finally drips from a cave ceiling, it releases carbon dioxide into the air.
Over thousands of years, these rings accumulate into the long stone icicles known as stalactites.
missing: This loss of gas forces a tiny amount of calcite out of the water, leaving a thin ring of mineral behind.
why: Sebep-sonuç zinciri: 3. cümlede su karbondioksit kaybeder, eksik cümlede bu kayıp geride bir mineral halkası bırakır. 4. cümledeki 'these rings' (bu halkalar) ifadesinin karşılığı yalnızca eksik cümlededir.
tr: Bu gaz kaybı, çok az miktarda kalsitin sudan ayrılmasına yol açar ve geride ince bir mineral halkası bırakır.

sentences: The anthropologist Robin Dunbar proposed that there is a natural limit of about 150 stable relationships per person.
Strikingly, groups of roughly this size also appear in human societies, from Neolithic villages to military companies.
Online platforms, however, allow users to collect thousands of so-called friends.
Studies of social media users nevertheless show that their meaningful interactions remain within Dunbar's limit.
missing: The estimate was derived from comparing brain size with typical group size across many primate species.
why: 2. cümledeki 'also appear in human societies' (insan toplumlarında da görülür) ifadesi, sayının önce insan dışı bir kaynaktan çıktığını varsayar. Bu kaynak, eksik cümledeki primat karşılaştırmasıdır.
tr: Bu tahmin, pek çok primat türünde beyin büyüklüğünün tipik grup büyüklüğüyle karşılaştırılmasından elde edildi.

sentences: The placebo effect occurs when patients improve after receiving a treatment with no active ingredient.
For decades, researchers assumed that it worked only if patients were deceived.
In a 2010 Harvard study, however, patients were given sugar pills and openly told that the pills were inactive.
Remarkably, these patients reported significantly greater relief from their symptoms than an untreated group.
missing: Such findings suggest that the ritual of treatment itself may trigger the body's healing responses.
why: 'Such findings' (bu tür bulgular) bir deney sonucuna atıf yapar. Sonuç ancak 4. cümlede verildiği için eksik cümle paragrafı genel bir yorumla kapatır.
tr: Bu tür bulgular, tedavi ritüelinin kendisinin vücudun iyileşme tepkilerini tetikleyebileceğini düşündürüyor.

sentences: Medieval builders who designed Gothic cathedrals wanted walls filled with enormous windows of stained glass.
Large openings, however, weakened the walls that had to carry the heavy stone roof.
The solution was the flying buttress, an external arch that transferred this thrust to piers outside the building.
Freed from their structural burden, the walls could finally become frames for light.
missing: The weight of the vaulted ceiling pushed outward and threatened to topple the thinned walls.
why: 3. cümledeki 'this thrust' (bu itme kuvveti) ifadesinin karşılığı eksik cümledeki 'pushed outward' (dışa doğru itti) kısmıdır. Sorun zayıflayan duvarlarla başlar, eksik cümleyle tehlikeye dönüşür, 3. cümlede de çözülür.
tr: Tonozlu tavanın ağırlığı dışa doğru itiyor ve incelmiş duvarları devirme tehdidi oluşturuyordu.

sentences: In the 1920s, the psychologist Bluma Zeigarnik observed something curious in a Berlin restaurant.
Waiters could remember complex unpaid orders perfectly but forgot them almost immediately after the bill was settled.
Intrigued, she designed laboratory experiments in which participants were interrupted during simple tasks.
Afterwards, the participants recalled the interrupted tasks considerably better than the completed ones.
missing: Some writers deliberately stop work in the middle of a sentence to exploit this tendency the next morning.
why: Eksik cümle, ilkenin günümüzdeki bir uygulamasıdır. 'this tendency' (bu eğilim) ifadesi, 4. cümlede deneyle kanıtlanan 'yarım kalan işin akılda kalması' eğilimine işaret eder. Daha önce konursa garson gözleminden deneye geçişi böler.
tr: Bazı yazarlar, ertesi sabah bu eğilimden yararlanmak için işi bilerek bir cümlenin ortasında bırakır.

sentences: Plants cannot run from danger, but many have developed surprising chemical defenses.
When giraffes begin feeding on an acacia tree, its leaves quickly fill with bitter tannins.
The damaged tree also releases ethylene gas into the surrounding air.
Giraffes appear to have learned this lesson, as they usually feed while moving against the wind.
missing: Neighboring acacias that detect the gas start producing tannins before the giraffes even reach them.
why: Eksik cümle, 3. cümledeki 'ethylene gas' kavramını 'the gas' diye sürdürür. 4. cümledeki 'this lesson' (bu ders), rüzgârla taşınan uyarı sayesinde komşu ağaçların önceden savunmaya geçmesidir.
tr: Bu gazı algılayan komşu akasyalar, zürafalar daha yanlarına ulaşmadan tanen üretmeye başlar.

sentences: Many students prepare for exams by reading their notes over and over again.
This method feels productive because the material becomes increasingly familiar.
Familiarity, however, is not the same as the ability to recall information without help.
